name: smwblocks-16x8-on-off-button-switch
title: 16x8 on/off button switch
description:
These 2 switches are very similar to On/off button switch ver.4
but there are differences between that block and this block:

-the side can be activated from side and they are passable.
-a block wide and 1/2 block tall.
-touching anywere on the top half of this blocks won't press it.

This is useful for skull kart/SML Marine Pop levels so mario can't "crash" into the sides of the switch, making it easier to activate it.

Read the instructions on how to setup this block.
*fixed a bug when big mario lands on the switch from above and the bottom offset doesn't run.
